body: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.
summaryZh: 本文提出了“前沿学习”（Frontier Learning），这是一种用于大模型推理能力后训练的开放式强化学习方法。针对传统固定问题池在模型进步后学习信号枯竭的问题，该方法利用程序生成器在线生成具有挑战性的训练问题，并根据模型能力动态调整难度。实验证明，该方法在多个推理任务中均优于固定池基准，强调了持续生成前沿难度问题对提升模型推理能力的重要性。
